title: stake/unstake/claim not poolState-gated during Migrating (no auto-pause) — asymmetric vs depositFor which IS Active-gated
description: NFTStakerDepletion's stake/unstake/claim entrypoints are not gated on poolState during the Migrating state, and there is no auto-pause. This is asymmetric with depositFor, which IS Active-gated. Interactions remain value-conserving throughout, but the missing state gate means stakers can still mutate positions while a migration is in progress.
impact: No asset risk — interactions remain value-conserving. The deviation is the inconsistent state-gating: depositFor is Active-gated while stake/unstake/claim are not poolState-gated during Migrating, and there is no auto-pause to freeze positions while a migration runs. Low severity (state-handling / consistency).
attackPath: 1. depositFor is gated to the Active poolState.
2. stake/unstake/claim are NOT poolState-gated and there is no auto-pause.
3. During the Migrating state, stakers can still stake/unstake/claim, asymmetric with the depositFor gate. Value is conserved throughout.
recommendation: Gate stake/unstake/claim on poolState consistently with depositFor (or auto-pause position-mutating entrypoints during Migrating) so position mutation is frozen while a migration is in progress, eliminating the asymmetry.
